messages.snippet: Hi James, Are you still on for 5-a-side Saturday morning at the Shoreditch pitches? We're one short.
messages.subject: Saturday 5-a-side?
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi James,

Are you still on for 5-a-side Saturday morning at the Shoreditch pitches? We're one short. Let me know — kick-off 10am.

Cheers,
Reb

(Sorry if this is the wrong James — got the address from the old league sheet!)
